desc: 象牙白双人开背藤编吊篮，晨光植物角悬空小窝成套卖点位
leaf: 双人开背藤编吊篮吊椅（吊挂式）
name: 象牙白双人开背藤编吊篮吊椅款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒讲清「家里悬出一个属于自己的小窝」，用晨光、叶影与真实盆栽把双人吊篮的情绪和体量一次立住。
shots.textZone: 左上留白：拱顶细线小标签「{callout_1}」，主标题「{selling_point_1}」两行，其下一行细字「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 同机位分屏放大「客厅角落堆满落地大件、想有个独处位置却没地方」的真实痛点，逼出悬空不占地的需求。
shots.textZone: 顶部 #2E4238 色带一行主标「{selling_point_1}」，两格底角各一枚拱顶小标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 一页把整只吊篮的六个可看点排成一眼可读的图标总览，承接首屏情绪并提前把后面每一屏的锚点铺好。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_2}」；六枚拱形图标各配短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_6}」，一律通用词不含数值

shots.intent: 把吊篮上真实存在的几种编法并排成同一光同比例的对照栏，让工艺差别自己看得见，替掉源页空洞的材料口号。
shots.textZone: 底部 #EAE9E0 色带主标「{selling_point_3}」，三栏顶缘各一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 微距证明开背卷纹的走线一致、底部包覆收口干净，把「藤编会不会毛糙散架」的疑虑落到可见证据上。
shots.textZone: 右侧留白带：小标题「{selling_point_4}」与其下一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，1px 引线连到卷纹收口

shots.intent: 贴地仰视把顶部吊环、织带与金属扣在正常受力下的真实状态做实，回答「挂得稳不稳、扣件长什么样」这一最直接的疑虑。
shots.textZone: 底部一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，以 1px 引线连到织带与扣件交接处

shots.intent: 低角度实景把吊篮放回一个真实可坐的阳台角落，用匿名被裁切的坐姿人物与真盆栽给出可信尺度，让人代入自己那个角落。
shots.textZone: 左下角一枚细字标签「{callout_2}」，不加其它文字

shots.intent: 一屏排开真实可选的坐垫与抱枕配色组合，让买家按自家墙面先把选型这一犹豫解决掉。
shots.textZone: 每个变体底缘一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，同一条对齐基线

shots.intent: 用悬放正视图加通用规格表和选配清单把「包含什么、怎么选」摊开，用透明结构而不是参数口号降风险。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_5}」；三张卡片各一枚标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」；下方四行通用规格表，行名为通用词、数值全部为占位符「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 同一角落的暮色收口，把整页情绪落回每天可以躲进去的那一小时，再给一个明确的咨询动作。
shots.textZone: 下方三分之一留白：主标「{selling_point_1}」，圆角按钮「{callout_3}」填色 #2E4238

style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real sun-corner interior with a pale limewash wall #EAE9E0, one slim vertical window mullion shadow and a honed terrazzo floor #D5D2C8 with one leafy potted plant as the scale anchor; a seamless pale sprout studio field #EAE9E0 or pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, weave diagrams and spec screens; and one flat deep moss graphic band #2E4238 for process and trust layouts; photographs are always enclosed in arch-topped 1px hairline frames in #2E4238 echoing the basket arch, one clean copy zone per screen, never busy decor
style.direction: sunlit conservatory lounge commerce, low morning sun in a plant corner with arch-topped graphic frames rather than airy nordic daylight, ink-and-rice-paper editorial or a mid-tone charcoal graphic interior
style.iconSystem: 1.2px single-stroke pictograms drawn inside slender arch-topped outlines that echo the basket silhouette, step markers as small solid moss dots #2E4238 hung from a 1px vertical drop line labelled 01 through 06 in #EAE9E0, maximum six per screen, 1px hairline rules for tables; no square number chips, no circular-framed pictograms, no solid ink discs, no filled illustration, no 3D badges, no gradient seals
style.lightingSystem: low morning sun at 5000-5200K entering from a declared off-frame window at camera left, crisp but believable leaf-shadow dappling thrown on the wall behind the chair, a soft sage bounce fill on the shadow side so the ivory frame stays readable, one narrow satin edge running down the tubular seat rim, and a real soft floor shadow pooled directly beneath every suspended body so nothing floats; the closing screen may add a single 2700K warm practical while all other screens stay morning-sun only; this is deliberately NOT a cool 6500K north-daylight wash and NOT a flat neutral 4200K downlight wash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sunlit conservatory lounge visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale sprout-white limewash wall #EAE9E0, deep moss graphic band #2E4238, honed terrazzo floor #D5D2C8, ivory basket frame #E9E2CE, sage leaf accent #A9B48C and dark moss copy colour #26302A; warm grade; one medium-weight humanist sans family with slightly rounded terminals, all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short with one letter-spaced uppercase English kicker as the only secondary voice; backgrounds limited to a real sun-corner interior with a pale limewash wall #EAE9E0, one slim vertical window mullion shadow and a terrazzo floor #D5D2C8 with one leafy potted plant as scale anchor, a seamless pale sprout studio field or pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, weave diagrams and spec screens, and one flat deep moss band #2E4238 for process and trust layouts, with photographs enclosed in arch-topped 1px hairline frames in #2E4238 echoing the basket arch and one clean copy zone per screen; lighting always low morning sun at 5000-5200K entering from a declared off-frame window at camera left, crisp believable leaf-shadow dappling on the wall behind the chair, soft sage bounce on the shadow side, one narrow satin edge along the tubular seat rim, and a real soft floor shadow pooled under every suspended body so nothing floats, the closing screen alone may add a 2700K practical; surface system of matte limewash plaster, honed terrazzo #D5D2C8, matte woven cushion cloth #B7B7B1 and #6B6B68, the frame rendered as the real smooth moulded open weave supplied with a soft satin edge only and never gloss or vinyl; layout system of arch-topped photo cards, 1px hairline leader lines and small solid moss dots #2E4238 hung from a 1px drop line as the 01-06 step markers, with at most six 1.2px single-stroke pictograms inside arch outlines; product presentation rules: identical wide two-person basket body, open scroll-and-hourglass back weave, flat oval top hanger bar, wrapped tubular seat rim with looped under-frame, one seat cushion plus two loose pillows, unchanged ivory tone #E9E2CE and one black strap #2B2B2B with a plain carabiner loaded straight in vertical tension in every frame, body hanging upright and settled with a grounded soft shadow beneath, corrected straight verticals, one real furnishing anchoring human scale, any person anonymous and cropped at shoulders or jaw and seated normally under ordinary load, the 3/4 morning-sun hanging angle reused across scene screens; no color palette changes, no recoloured or re-woven basket, no invented load capacity, tube gauge, material grade, UV or waterproof rating, dimension, warranty term or certificate, no drilling or mount installation shown, no standing on the chair, no unattended child, no tipped empty chair, no visible face, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon or step-marker styles, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership badges.

style.presentationRules: the hanging chair keeps one proportional scale and one identity in every frame: the same wide two-person basket body, the same open scroll-and-hourglass back weave, the same flat oval top hanger bar, the same wrapped tubular seat rim with its looped under-frame, the same one seat cushion plus two loose pillows, the same ivory frame tone #E9E2CE and the same single black strap #2B2B2B with a plain carabiner loaded straight in vertical tension; the body hangs upright and settled, never tilted as if falling, with a grounded soft shadow beneath it; interior verticals, wall corners, mullion lines and floor edges stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (plant on the floor, side stool, rug edge) always anchors human scale; any person is anonymous, cropped at shoulders or jaw or seen from behind, seated normally with the strap and hardware under ordinary load, never standing or kneeling on the chair and never an unsupervised child; the 3/4 morning-sun hanging angle of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one corner
style.surfaceSystem: matte limewash plaster #EAE9E0, honed terrazzo floor #D5D2C8 with a faint aggregate speckle, matte woven cushion cloth in light greige #B7B7B1 and deep grey #6B6B68, the basket frame rendered as the real smooth moulded open weave supplied in ivory #E9E2CE with visible strand overlap and a soft satin edge only, never gloss lacquer, never vinyl or leather sheen, matte ceramic pot #E9E7DF and matte black webbing strap #2B2B2B with a plain metal carabiner
style.typography: one medium-weight humanist sans family with slightly rounded terminals only; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 26-32pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-12pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters, one letter-spaced uppercase English kicker line as the only secondary voice; never a Ming serif, never a heavy bold geometric display face, no mixing of families
